messages:
alex.ng: FYI invoices for a few tenants showed negative 'carryover' credits this morning after the quota-rollout canary. noticed ~5 customers, small amounts. anyone seen this pattern before?

maya: saw a spike in ingest queue time around the rollout window. might be reordering some events so credits get applied twice then dedup fires late :/ :eyes:

sam.k: can you paste the invoice IDs? I can grep the ledger. my hunch is routing fallback added duplicate routing-tag headers that our dedupe key ignores.

alex.ng: invoice ids: INV-2026-0451, INV-2026-0499, INV-2026-0522. attaching the preview diff I pulled from staging.

chloe: quick note — console preview shows delta but UX hides exact events if more than 3. that's why support didn't escalate earlier. we should surface the raw event list in the preview for canaries.

alex.ng: here's the ingest log snippet around INV-2026-0499 (sanitized):

```
2026-03-19T09:42:12.123Z ingest: received event {tenant: "t-17", route_tag: "fallback-v2", fingerprint: "f1"}
2026-03-19T09:42:12.125Z ingest: received event {tenant: "t-17", route_tag: "primary", fingerprint: "f1"}
2026-03-19T09:42:12.130Z deduper: candidate f1 seen, window=30s, key=route+fingerprint -> accepted
2026-03-19T09:42:12.200Z aggregator: write credit -10 -> invoice preview
```

ravi: looks like ordering caused primary to be processed after fallback, deduper key used `route+fingerprint` so those two events escaped dedupe because route differs. we used to dedupe on `fingerprint+session` earlier.

sam.k: ok that matches my guess. rollout changed header canonicalization. we need a short-term fix and a longer-term telemetry change. short-term: update dedupe key to ignore route for the next 48h for ingest path. long-term: emit `metering.ingest.fingerprint_variants` metric and a dashboard to see how often fingerprint+route differ.

maya: agree. small flag flip for 48h would be quick. but we should also add a per-tenant "unmerged-event-rate" to the console so CS can triage. current graphing hides small tenants.

chloe: UX ask: show a red banner in invoice preview when dedupe-uncertainty > 0.1% with link to raw events. small change but reduces support noise.

ingest-bot: ALERT: metering.ingest.queue_time_ms p95 spiked from 60ms -> 1.2s at 2026-03-19T09:42:00Z. correlated_events=540, affected_tenants=4

ravi: ingest-bot stats support the queue-time explanation. I'll open an ops wheelfix to temporarily relax route canonicalization in the deduper. sam, can you own the metric + grafana panel?

sam.k: yep. I'll add a panel with these metrics: `metering.ingest.queue_time_ms`, `metering.ingest.fingerprint_variants`, `metering.deduper.ignored_by_route`. will also add an alert rule thresholded per-tenant.

maya: tagging @chloe for the UI banner change. can we ship that as a config flag on invoice preview? then we can toggle without full deploy.

chloe: yep, can prototype flag today. will mock in console and link raw-events modal.

alex.ng: thanks folks. plan = (1) ravi flips dedupe key ignore-route for 48h, (2) sam ships metrics + panel + alert, (3) chloe adds preview banner flag, (4) follow-up postmortem if negative invoices > $0.5 total. i'll create a short runbook for CS. :thumbsup:

sam.k: creating dashboard PR and alert, pinging here when live.

ravi: rolling the change now (canary first). will post results in 10m.

ingest-bot: DEPLOY: deduper flag toggled to `ignore_route=true` in canary at 2026-03-19T09:52:10Z

ravi: canary looks clean, no negative preview diffs in canary tenants. rolling to prod in 5m.

alex.ng: added runbook draft under /confluence/metering/runbooks/negative-invoice-detection. please review and add any missing triage steps.

chloe: mock for flag UI posted in #design later today.

sam.k: dashboard live: https://grafana.redwood/metering/boards/ingest-duplicates (panel `fingerprint_variants`)

maya: thanks all. great cross-team quick response. we'll follow up with the PM to schedule a dedupe-key design review so we don't rely on flags long term.

alex.ng: closing the thread — reopening if anything else pops up.
